scope: Exploratory activation-assisted direct weight edit; one natural mechanism family, not weight-only understanding or an established causal semantic direction
observations: 392 fresh diagnostic-discovery rows: among 1/27 and werewolf 0/35 labelled falsehoods detected; game-family honest and deceptive scores both low. Non-game recall much higher. Some game texts explicitly describe fabricated alibis/roles, while all probes still assign low scores. No anomalous large coefficient is present in the natural baseline.
mechanism_hypothesis: A game-context/format direction is penalized by the detector independently of completion label; removing its component may recover game detections while preserving other evidence.
competing_explanation: Games differ in content, length, strategy and label validity; their truth evidence may be absent or poorly linearly separable in last-token activations. The contrast is observational and may also contain useful truth information. A source-group contrast does not by itself isolate formatting causally.
direction: For each probe, class-balance standardized activation means within every family; average among/werewolf means and subtract the average of the four non-game family means. Normalize to a unit direction. Use diagnostic-discovery groups only. This uses labels only to balance the source contrast and does not fit an honest-vs-deceptive classifier.
exact_edit: For all six probe vectors, w' = w - alpha*u*(u dot w); leave b, mu, sd, pooling and equal sigmoid aggregation fixed. Alpha=1 is the sole primary candidate. Alpha=.5 and 1.5 are dose checks, not alternative winners. -1 is wrong-direction control; include zero, six single-probe isolations and one orthogonal norm-matched random patch.
diagnostic_selection: Primary alpha=1 must pass tensor-form checks and all four registered transfer predictions. If any fails, reject this natural mechanism and keep original; do not select another dose from transfer feedback. If it passes, evaluate once on separate validation calibration/evaluation; adoption still requires paired recall-difference 95% lower bound >0 and observed FPR<=.05.
final_test: Still closed; no final-calibration or final-test prediction scores have been accessed. An engineered-fault repair generated by the independent evaluator is a separate positive-control artifact and cannot be promoted as a natural detector improvement.
